# SL UI source

Component: `matte-text-input`. Variant: `text-input`.
Exported from the installed SL UI Library 1.2.4 bundle.

The Settings search adapts the native input/label structure and the original
floating-label and soft-focus CSS. React retains ownership of the search value,
results and navigation; the standalone controller is retained as source reference.
Field dimensions, font and colors follow CanvasTTY's sidebar tokens. The helper
remains accessible without adding visible copy. Reduced-motion and forced-color
rules come from the exported stylesheet.
